subjects.correctionPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and semantic reference: an actual long skipping/jump rope with two short handles and a long coiled cord. Image 2 (the simplified drum) is ONLY the rendering style reference. Redesign image 1 as one clear casual mobile puzzle sprite. Preserve the identity SKIPPING ROPE, Russian скакалка, not a spring expander, headphones, cable or rubber tube. Make TWO SHORT chunky teal handles, each only about one fifth of the overall icon height, placed a little asymmetrically in the lower foreground. From their ends ONE LONG SLENDER plain coral cord makes one broad loose oval coil occupying most of the image above them. Cord width about ONE QUARTER of handle width. It must visibly have a long slack flexible cord, not a stiff short U-shaped arch between large grips. Keep the composition/readability of image 1 but use just ONE loose coil, no multiple coils, stripes, knots or grip ribs. Match image 2's matte broad clean color masses and soft simple volume, no realistic grain, gloss, metal glints, fine details or decoration. Transparent background with true zero alpha outside the rope and in all loop gaps, no floor, haze, halo, backplate, text, face or watermark. One complete centered object, ample transparent padding, no drum or UI.
